verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents its own bank and credit card reconciliation workflow, and its AI Close feature uses AI agents to reconcile accounts and surface discrepancies, so the core per-account reconciliation is first-party. The evidence does not describe matched versus unmatched views or duplicate detection for review. Missing for 10: explicit matched/unmatched transaction surfacing, duplicate-transaction detection, detail on the reconciliation review UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can reconcile each bank account against the ledger with matched, unmatched, and duplicate transactions surfaced for review

citations.quote: performing a reconciliation is the best way to ensure every single transaction is accounted for and matches your bank statement exactly
AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.
